name: screeps-arena-game-api-cpp
description: Write Screeps: Arena bots in C++, compiled to WASM, with a local simulator

scripts.build: scripts/with-emsdk.sh cmake --preset wasm && scripts/with-emsdk.sh cmake --build --preset wasm
scripts.build:debug: scripts/with-emsdk.sh cmake --preset wasm-debug && scripts/with-emsdk.sh cmake --build --preset wasm-debug
scripts.test: npm run test:cpp && npm run test:sim
scripts.test:cpp: cmake --preset native && cmake --build --preset native && ctest --preset native
